payload.description_html: Virtual reconstruction of the right lacrimal of Vegavis geitononesos (MLP-PV 15-I-7-52). Lacrimal in (a) lateral, (b) rostral, (c) medial, and (d) caudal views. Abbreviations: ffn, facies articularis frontonasalis; pso, processus supraorbitalis lacrimalis; pol., processus orbitalis lacrimalis. Scale bar = 10 mm.
